questions.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS clients_factures_2025_pas_2026 FROM analytics.sales_lines AS s WHERE s.invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND s.invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics.sales_lines AS s2 WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s2.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND s2.invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE))

WITH rev AS (SELECT c.region, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(s.net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.sales_lines AS s JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE s.invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND s.invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.region, c.customer_id, c.customer_name), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM rev) SELECT region, customer_id, customer_name, ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY net_revenue_2025 DESC

WITH q AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS INT) AS invoice_year, CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM invoice_date) AS INT) AS invoice_quarter, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2), g AS (SELECT invoice_year, invoice_quarter, net_revenue, LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY invoice_year, invoice_quarter) AS previous_quarter_revenue FROM q) SELECT invoice_year AS year, invoice_quarter AS quarter, ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue_eur, ROUND(previous_quarter_revenue, 2) AS previous_quarter_net_revenue_eur, ROUND(100 * (net_revenue - previous_quarter_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_quarter_revenue, 0), 2) AS growth_vs_previous_quarter_pct FROM g WHERE invoice_year = 2026 ORDER BY invoice_quarter

questions.executed_sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY customer_id), top20 AS (SELECT revenue FROM rev ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id LIMIT 20) SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM top20), 2) AS ca_net_top20_2025, ROUND((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM rev), 2) AS ca_net_total_2025, ROUND((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM top20) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM rev), 0), 4) AS part_top20

questions.executed_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1), diffs AS (SELECT month_start, net_revenue, LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_month_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_start) AS INT) AS month_number, ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(previous_month_revenue, 2) AS previous_month_net_revenue, ROUND(net_revenue - previous_month_revenue, 2) AS revenue_increase, ROUND((net_revenue - previous_month_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_month_revenue, 0), 4) AS revenue_growth_rate FROM diffs WHERE month_start >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

questions.executed_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) AS total_remises_eur, ROUND(SUM(gross_amount), 2) AS montant_brut_eur, ROUND(SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0), 4) AS taux_remise FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)

WITH retard AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM analytics.invoices WHERE is_overdue), base AS (SELECT c.segment, (r.customer_id IS NULL) AS sans_retard FROM analytics.customers AS c LEFT JOIN retard AS r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id) SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sans_retard) AS clients_sans_facture_en_retard, COUNT(*) AS clients_total, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN sans_retard THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS part_sans_retard FROM base GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment

SELECT c.segment AS customer_segment, ROUND(CAST(AVG(i.days_paid_late) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_days_paid_late, COUNT(*) AS settled_invoices FROM analytics.invoices AS i JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.is_settled AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY average_days_paid_late DESC
